      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_PoliceApp" name="Police app">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_SuccessfulService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ServiceNecessary</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Registered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyOwner</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueFine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Fined</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CarOwner" name="Car owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ServiceOrTimer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_CarArrives</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ThirtyDays</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PayThroughApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Mechanic" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterProblems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RepairCar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterNextServiceTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NextServiceRecorded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SuccessfulService" name="Successful service completed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ToNecessary</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceNecessary" name="Service becomes necessary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ToNecessary</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Necessary_ToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_ServiceNecessary">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">serviceNecessary</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check whether car is still registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Necessary_ToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_ToRegistered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car registered?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_NotRegistered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_ToRegistered</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Registered</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotRegistered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify car owner">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_ToEventGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ServiceOrTimer" name="Wait for service or 30 days" gatewayDirection="Diverging" eventGatewayType="Exclusive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_ToEventGateway</bpmn:incoming>

        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">carArrivesForService</bpmn:condition>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ThirtyDays" name="30 days pass without service">

    </bpmn:task>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fine_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotRegistered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Arrival_ToProblems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Problems_ToParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Repair and status updates" gatewayDirection="Diverging">

    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair car">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repair_ToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ToUpdates</bpmn:incoming>

    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Repair and updates complete" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repair_ToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Updates_ToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_ToPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_ToPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_ToSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl" name="Enter successful repair and Pickerl">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_ToSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SuccessfulRepair_ToNextService</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" name="Enter time for next service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SuccessfulRepair_ToNextService</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NextService_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NextServiceRecorded" name="Next service time recorded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NextService_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ToNecessary" sourceRef="Start_SuccessfulService" targetRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Necessary_ToCheck" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ToRegistered" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">carIsRegistered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="Not registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_ToEventGateway" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceOrTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_ToArrival" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrTimer" targetRef="Catch_CarArrives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_ToThirtyDays" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrTimer" targetRef="Catch_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine" sourceRef="Catch_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fine_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Arrival_ToProblems" sourceRef="Catch_CarArrives" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Problems_ToParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ToRepair" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ToUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_ToJoin" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_ToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_ToPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_ToSuccessfulRepair" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SuccessfulRepair_ToNextService" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl" targetRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextService_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" targetRef="End_NextServiceRecorded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CarRegistered" name="Car still registered?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_NotRegistered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_ToRegisteredGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Registered</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotRegistered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify car owner">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_ToWaitGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ServiceOrDeadline" name="Wait for service or 30 days" gatewayDirection="Diverging" eventGatewayType="Exclusive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_ToWaitGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_ToCarArrival</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_ToThirtyDays</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CarArrivesForService" name="Car arrives for service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_ToCarArrival</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CarArrival_ToEnterProblems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_CarArrivesForService">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">carArrivesForService</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ThirtyDays" name="30 days pass without service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_ToThirtyDays</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Timer_ThirtyDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ImposeFine" name="Fine car owner">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fine_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Car owner fined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fine_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car is not registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotRegistered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCarProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CarArrival_ToEnterProblems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterProblems_ToEmailUpdates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReceiveEmailUpdates" name="Receive email status updates while waiting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterProblems_ToEmailUpdates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EmailUpdates_ToRepairDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RepairDone" name="Repair is done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EmailUpdates_ToRepairDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairDone_ToPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_RepairDone">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">repairDone</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairDone_ToPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_ToEnterSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl" name="Enter successful repair and Pickerl">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_ToEnterSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SuccessfulRepair_ToNextService</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" name="Enter time for next service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SuccessfulRepair_ToNextService</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NextService_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NextServiceRecorded" name="Next service time recorded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NextService_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ToServiceNecessary" sourceRef="Start_AfterSuccessfulService" targetRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ServiceNecessary_ToCheck" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ToRegisteredGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_CarRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_CarRegistered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">carIsRegistered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="Not registered" sourceRef="Gateway_CarRegistered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_ToWaitGateway" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceOrDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_ToCarArrival" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrDeadline" targetRef="Catch_CarArrivesForService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_ToThirtyDays" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrDeadline" targetRef="Catch_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine" sourceRef="Catch_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_ImposeFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fine_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ImposeFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CarArrival_ToEnterProblems" sourceRef="Catch_CarArrivesForService" targetRef="Task_EnterCarProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterProblems_ToEmailUpdates" sourceRef="Task_EnterCarProblems" targetRef="Task_ReceiveEmailUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmailUpdates_ToRepairDone" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveEmailUpdates" targetRef="Catch_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDone_ToPayment" sourceRef="Catch_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_ToEnterSuccessfulRepair" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SuccessfulRepair_ToNextService" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl" targetRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextService_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" targetRef="End_NextServiceRecorded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceReminder" name="Service reminder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceArrival" name="Service arrival"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdate" name="Email status update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairDone" name="Repair done"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService" name="Car Service">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PoliceApp" name="Police app" processRef="Process_PoliceApp"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CarOwner" name="Car owner" processRef="Process_CarOwner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ServiceFacility" name="Car service facility" processRef="Process_ServiceFacility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceReminder" name="Service reminder" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Start_OwnerNotified" messageRef="Message_ServiceReminder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OwnerToFacility" name="Car arrives for service" sourceRef="Task_TakeCarToService" targetRef="Start_CarArrives" messageRef="Message_ServiceArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OwnerToPolice" name="Car arrives for service" sourceRef="Task_TakeCarToService" targetRef="Catch_CarArrives" messageRef="Message_ServiceArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdate" name="Email status update" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairDone" name="Repair done" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRepairDone" targetRef="Catch_RepairDone" messageRef="Message_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment" name="Payment" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="Task_ReceivePayment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PoliceApp" name="Police service reminders" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AfterSuccessfulService" name="Successful service completed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ToServiceNecessary</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceNecessary" name="Service becomes necessary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ToServiceNecessary</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ServiceNecessary_ToCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_ServiceNecessary">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">serviceNecessary</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check whether car is still registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ServiceNecessary_ToCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_ToRegisteredGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CarRegistered" name="Car still registered?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_NotRegistered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_ToRegisteredGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Registered</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotRegistered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify car owner" messageRef="Message_ServiceReminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_ToWaitGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ServiceOrDeadline" name="Wait for service or 30 days" gatewayDirection="Diverging" eventGatewayType="Exclusive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_ToWaitGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_ToCarArrival</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_ToThirtyDays</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CarArrives" name="Car arrives for service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_ToCarArrival</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CarArrival_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEvent_CarArrives" messageRef="Message_ServiceArrival"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceAttended" name="Car taken to service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CarArrival_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ThirtyDays" name="30 days pass without service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_ToThirtyDays</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="Timer_ThirtyDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ImposeFine" name="Fine car owner">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fine_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Car owner fined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fine_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car is not registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotRegistered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ToServiceNecessary" sourceRef="Start_AfterSuccessfulService" targetRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ServiceNecessary_ToCheck" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ToRegisteredGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_CarRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_CarRegistered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">carIsRegistered</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="Not registered" sourceRef="Gateway_CarRegistered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_ToWaitGateway" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceOrDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_ToCarArrival" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrDeadline" targetRef="Catch_CarArrives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_ToThirtyDays" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrDeadline" targetRef="Catch_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CarArrival_ToEnd" sourceRef="Catch_CarArrives" targetRef="End_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThirtyDays_ToFine" sourceRef="Catch_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_ImposeFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fine_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ImposeFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CarOwner" name="Car owner service visit" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OwnerNotified" name="Service reminder received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OwnerStart_ToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEvent_OwnerNotified" messageRef="Message_ServiceReminder"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GoToService" name="Go to service?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_OwnerDoesNotGo"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TakeCarToService" name="Take car to service facility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OwnerGoesToService</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TakeCar_ToReceiveUpdates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" name="Receive email status updates while waiting" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TakeCar_ToReceiveUpdates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Updates_ToRepairDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RepairDone" name="Repair is done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Updates_ToRepairDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairDone_ToPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEvent_RepairDone" messageRef="Message_RepairDone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairDone_ToPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OwnerPaid" name="Payment made">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OwnerDoesNotGo" name="Does not go to service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OwnerDoesNotGo</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OwnerStart_ToDecision" sourceRef="Start_OwnerNotified" targetRef="Gateway_GoToService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OwnerGoesToService" name="Goes to service" sourceRef="Gateway_GoToService" targetRef="Task_TakeCarToService">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">goesToService</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OwnerDoesNotGo" name="Does not go" sourceRef="Gateway_GoToService" targetRef="End_OwnerDoesNotGo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeCar_ToReceiveUpdates" sourceRef="Task_TakeCarToService" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_ToRepairDone" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" targetRef="Catch_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDone_ToPayment" sourceRef="Catch_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="End_OwnerPaid"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ServiceFacility" name="Car service facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CarArrives" name="Car arrives for service">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FacilityStart_ToEnterProblems</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEvent_FacilityCarArrives" messageRef="Message_ServiceArrival"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCarProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FacilityStart_ToEnterProblems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterProblems_ToSendUpdates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdates" name="Send email status updates" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterProblems_ToSendUpdates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendUpdates_ToRepairDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyRepairDone" name="Notify owner that repair is done" messageRef="Message_RepairDone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendUpdates_ToRepairDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairDone_ToReceivePayment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePayment" name="Receive payment through the app" messageRef="Message_Payment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairDone_ToReceivePayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_ToEnterSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl" name="Enter successful repair and Pickerl">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_ToEnterSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SuccessfulRepair_ToNextService</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" name="Enter time for next service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SuccessfulRepair_ToNextService</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NextService_ToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NextServiceRecorded" name="Next service time recorded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NextService_ToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FacilityStart_ToEnterProblems" sourceRef="Start_CarArrives" targetRef="Task_EnterCarProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterProblems_ToSendUpdates" sourceRef="Task_EnterCarProblems" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendUpdates_ToRepairDone" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Task_NotifyRepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDone_ToReceivePayment" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRepairDone" targetRef="Task_ReceivePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_ToEnterSuccessfulRepair" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePayment" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SuccessfulRepair_ToNextService" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl" targetRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextService_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" targetRef="End_NextServiceRecorded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
